antiPatterns: No 'It's not X, it's Y' constructions
No em-dashes. Use commas, periods, colons instead
No elliptical setups like 'The best part?'
No revelation hooks like 'Here's the truth no one talks about'
No fractal summaries: don't summarize what you're about to say, say it, then summarize what you said
No 'In today's fast-paced world' or similar throat-clearing
No 'Thread' or similar meta-references with emoji
Avoid exclamation marks except in rare emphasis
brandVoiceDefaults: Specific over grandiose. Name the thing
Show your work. Reference the source material
Trust the reader. Skip unnecessary analogies and hand-holding
contentPrinciples: Every post must provide value: insight, framework, or provocation
Always attribute data and quotes to the source article
Write for the reader, not for the algorithm
Prefer concrete examples over abstract claims
Vary sentence length. Mix long and short. Let rhythm feel natural
